name: Karasugai Itsuka
source:
The first protagonist of [url=/v30959]Ayashigoto Banashi R[/url].

She's in the first year of middle school at the time the story starts.

Normally taciturn, she's actually very talkative when she's around the other art club members. She refers to herself using masculine pronouns and actually has a sharp tongue when around her family members or in a pinch.

She comes from a family of farmers and she lives in the north of Kodamamachi together with her parents, her grandparents and her two-years-older brother. Her cat's name is "Enokidake" (Enoki mushroom).

She woke [url=/c96850]Sougaku Kanon[/url] up from his sleep and has formed a contract with him.

She was childhood friends with [url=/c96859]Koufukugamori Sachiko[/url], but...

"You're a monster! Maki, this guy's a monster!"

[Translated from the game's character page]
